briefings.title: Robotics' End Game: Nvidia's Jim Fan

people.name: Jim Fan
people.role: Lead, Embodied Autonomous Research Group, NVIDIA

briefings.tldr: Jim Fan argues that robotics is undergoing "The Great Parallel" to the LLM playbook, transitioning from language-heavy models to World Action Models (WAM) trained on massive egocentric video datasets and neural simulations, aiming to pass the physical Turing test within 2–3 years.
